LanguageData.SRT_EnableInfectionsTip: Uses the best available medicine allowed by the patient's medical care setting.
LanguageData.SRT_EnableDiseasesTip: Uses the best available medicine allowed by the patient's medical care setting.
LanguageData.SRT_EnableInjuriesTip: Uses the weakest available medicine that can reasonably reach the injury target.
LanguageData.SRT_SkipSmallImprovement: Skip when the reasonably attainable improvement is small
LanguageData.SRT_SkipSmallImprovementTip: Compares the current quality with the best result that has at least a 50% chance of being reached within the available attempts.
LanguageData.SRT_AttemptsTip: Zero means unlimited. The job still stops if medicine runs out or the target becomes impossible.
LanguageData.SRT_NoLongerAvailable: No eligible treatment can currently be improved.
